initiatives.name: Seychelles Data Centre Sustainability Initiative
initiatives.summary: Airtel Africa is pursuing a net zero target by 2050, with a near-term target of reducing carbon emissions intensity by 62% from 2021/22 baseline levels. In 2025/26, it converted 390 sites from off-grid to grid, rolled out 550+ solar sites and 470 lean sites, and commissioned a solar photovoltaic system at its Seychelles data centre.

evidence.title: Net zero by 2050 and renewable energy expansion
evidence.summary: Airtel Africa is pursuing a net zero target by 2050, with a near-term target of reducing carbon emissions intensity by 62% from 2021/22 baseline levels. In 2025/26, it converted 390 sites from off-grid to grid, rolled out 550+ solar sites and 470 lean sites, and commissioned a solar photovoltaic system at its Seychelles data centre.
evidence.quote: We remain focused on our near-term target1 of reducing carbon emissions intensity2 by 62% from 2021/22 baseline levels. ... A key achievement was the modernisation of our tower infrastructure with 390 more sites converted from off-grid to grid, the rollout of over 550 solar sites and 470 lean sites to significantly lower the reliance on diesel and improve operational efficiency.

evidence.title: Seychelles data centre solar installation
evidence.summary: Airtel Africa commissioned a 71 kWp grid-tied solar photovoltaic system at its Seychelles data centre, delivering an estimated 7,828 kWh of clean energy monthly and contributing 8% of the facility's annual electricity demand, avoiding 43 tonnes of scope 2 emissions.
evidence.quote: In April 2025, we commissioned a 71 kWp grid-tied solar photovoltaic system at our Seychelles data centre, marking a significant milestone in our transition to renewable energy.

initiatives.name: Nigerian SEC Internal Control Compliance Programme

evidence.title: Compliance with Nigerian SEC Internal Control Requirements
